description.value:
Ammunition round or sling bullet

Activate 1 (manipulate)

Magekiller bullets are forged by carving a spellcaster's bones with sigils of unbinding, grinding them to powder, and sealing the powder within the core of specially made rounds or sling bullets. When an activated magekiller bullet hits a target, the ammunition burrows deep into its body and interferes with its connection to magic.

Each time within the next week an affected target Casts a Spell, it must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:11]. On a failure, it takes @Damage[2d12[force]] damage. This curse can be counteracted with cleanse affliction as normal, but if the ammunition is first removed from the target with a successful @Check[medicine|dc:35] check and an operation that takes 1 hour, the counteract check gains a +4 circumstance bonus.
